description: This file contains implementations of prime number utility functions, including finding the next greater prime and the lower prime relative to a given number, using a predefined list of primes.

methods.name: ocudu::prime_greater_than
methods.description: Returns the smallest prime number greater than the input n from a predefined list of primes.

methods.name: ocudu::prime_lower_than
methods.description: Returns the largest prime number less than the input n from a predefined list of primes.
